| 🍎 **[njrNotch](https://github.com/nikajr10/njrNotch)** | A macOS app that lives in the MacBook notch: Spotify controls with a seekable song timeline, plus live Claude Code status, usage limits and permission prompts.<br /><sub>Swift · SwiftUI · AppKit</sub> |
| 🎙️ **[SmartBiz AI](https://github.com/nikajr10/final-year-project)** | My final year project: inventory management for Nepali retail shops.
